QualityReason: pdfe implements /BrotliDecode (Excise.Core/Filters/PdfFilterRegistry.cs:91, PDF 2.0/ISO 32000-2). mutool and Ghostscript also decode it and draw the same rectangles pdfe does (diffFraction 3.1e-05 / 0.055 against pdfe). pdftocairo (Poppler) and PDFBox do not implement /BrotliDecode and render the page blank (diffFraction 0.831 / 0.867); the native pdfium oracle used by this scan shares Poppler's gap (0.831). Measured 2026-09-10 via a direct corpus-scan of test-pdfs/pdfium restricted to this fixture, --extra-oracles all, 150 dpi.
